findings.evidence: grep: prodMulEquivOfSimplyConnected only in FundamentalGroupProduct.lean; TorusFundamentalGroup.lean:52 uses FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv; roadmap UniversalCovers Stage 4 (README.md:141-145) names S¹/Tᵏ/RPⁿ/K(G,1), none collapsing a simply-connected factor; PR description states the cylinder application was already found off-roadmap and dropped.
findings.fix: Drop the collapse lemmas (and the supporting Unique instance if it serves only them), or have a human add a target requiring a simply-connected-factor collapse (e.g. the cylinder) to the roadmap first, then justify against it.
findings.issue: prodMulEquivOfSimplyConnectedRight/Left add a new capability (collapsing a simply-connected factor from π₁) not present on main; this is new mathematical content, not a refactor/generalization of prodMulEquiv (which is strictly more general). No named Stage 4 target uses it: π_n(Tᵏ) is built from prodMulEquiv/piMulEquiv over AddCircle p factors (TorusFundamentalGroup.lean:52), which are proven NOT simply connected (CircleNotSimplyConnected.lean:80). The lemmas are referenced nowhere else in the codebase, and the description's stated path ('on the path to the torus computation') is not real.

findings.evidence: instUnique's only use is the collapse pair (prodUnique/uniqueProd require Unique); those lemmas have no proximate roadmap target.
findings.fix: Remove together with the collapse lemmas, or fold into whatever in-scope target eventually needs it.
findings.issue: instUnique (Unique from Subsingleton for simply connected π₁) exists to feed MulEquiv.prodUnique/uniqueProd in the collapse lemmas; with no in-scope consumer it is off-roadmap infrastructure justified only as generally useful.

summary: The collapse lemmas are genuinely new content (a new capability: discarding a simply-connected π₁ factor), not a refactor of the merged prodMulEquiv, and have no proximate path to any named UniversalCovers Stage 4 target; the torus computation uses circle factors that are explicitly not simply connected, and the collapse's only application (the cylinder) was already dropped as off-roadmap.
